result.brief: 提出基于循环网络的脑电世界模型，用视听刺激条件预测未来10秒EEG频带功率动态，并借该框架比较V-JEPA 2等视觉表征的预测能力。
result.reason: Recurrent world model forecasting EEG dynamics conditioned on audiovisual input; evaluates V-JEPA 2 visual representations, but main contribution is neural forecasting, not video representation or world model.
